about.title: How these tools work
about.paste_title: Paste a video link in the editor
about.paste_body: Paste a bilibili link into a content page and it turns into a player. Seven forms are recognised: the video page, a page with a part number, the mobile host, an av id, a b23.tv short link, an existing player URL, and the whole official iframe snippet. Douyin and Tencent links are still inserted, but you are asked to preview them because we could not verify their players ourselves.
about.qr_body: On Users → Signups, every invite code row has a QR button. Download the SVG to print it or share it.
about.transfer_title: What import and export can carry
about.transfer_body: Only content pages and full-page embeds survive the round trip. Original video and PDF files are not in the archive, and assignments should be moved with the assignment tools. Import always creates new chapters and never overwrites what is already there.
about.avatar_body: The script is never stored on the server. It is compressed into the part of the link after the #. The page reads it with the browser's own speech synthesis and drives the avatar's mouth and captions. That is why the link is long, and why it must not be edited by hand — change it and the script is gone.
